name: Impcaller on the action bar is saved as Call: Hellfire Imp (#5469)
contract: AscensionCompatData::TalentReplacements (AscensionTalentReplacementData.h:35) carries {17, 17, 706755, 804883, {{707666 at 0}}}: in Defiance specialization 17, knowing the Impcaller talent 706755 turns Call: Hellfire Imp 804883 into Impcaller 707666. AscensionClassService::SynchronizeTalentReplacements (AscensionCompat.cpp:884-953), run from OnPlayerLearnSpell (AscensionCompat.cpp:5782-5784), teaches 707666 with learnSpell(707666, true) (AscensionCompat.cpp:945), a temporary spell never written to character_spell, and registers it over Call: Hellfire Imp with Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement (AscensionCompat.cpp:951). Before the fix Player::_SaveActions wrote 707666, and Player::_LoadActions at the next login runs before the class service teaches it again, so the button was refused and deleted. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the id _SaveActions writes. A button holding Impcaller must be saved as Call: Hellfire Imp; a button holding Call: Hellfire Imp is saved unchanged. With CoA.TemporarySpellReplacement.Silent the Impcaller swap and the Shieldgore swap of the same Defiance Knight (Shieldgore rank 1 804353 over Infernal Strike 801016, neither spell with a SpellCustomAttr row) print no chat line on swap-in or swap-out and the client keeps the replacement after the server drops it.

steps.label: Let login state settle
Choose Defiance
Start without the Shieldgore talent Defiance grants
SETUP: Infernal Strike is its own spell without the talent
Infernal Strike on a button the Shieldgore swap will redraw
SETUP: the login bar was sent and button 120 is empty
Pick the Shieldgore talent
Shieldgore rank 1 stands in for Infernal Strike
The server bar holds Shieldgore on the Infernal Strike button
The Infernal Strike button shows Shieldgore
QUIET: Shieldgore rank 1 has no SpellCustomAttr row and was still taught without a line
QUIET: the client holds Shieldgore
Pick the Impcaller talent
The talent replaces Call: Hellfire Imp with Impcaller
QUIET: Impcaller has no SpellCustomAttr row and was still taught without a line
QUIET: the client holds Impcaller
The bar holds Impcaller
The Impcaller button is saved as Call: Hellfire Imp
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
Drop the Shieldgore talent
Infernal Strike is its own spell again
The button shows Infernal Strike again
The server dropped Shieldgore
QUIET: the client keeps Shieldgore instead of an unlearned line
QUIET: swapping Shieldgore out printed nothing
Drop the Impcaller talent
Call: Hellfire Imp is its own spell again
The server dropped Impcaller
QUIET: the client keeps Impcaller instead of an unlearned line
QUIET: swapping Impcaller out printed nothing
QUIET: an empty button stays empty
QUIET: no swap was sent as SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL
